title: AutoStory True Crime Editorial A/B/C/D Benchmark

sourceVideo.caseTitle: Entitled Driver Abandons Car In Traffic / Misuse of 911

A.name: Free Editorial Gemini
A.description: Direct multimodal examination with full autonomy over story count, hook selection, central question, and narrative structure. No forced 3-part serialization, no preselected hook anchors, no mandatory flashbacks.

B.name: Existing Pipeline (Baseline)
B.description: Current production pipeline using 01-gemini-highlight-scripts-prompt.txt with locked SERIES HOOK CONTRACT forcing 3-part serialization and regex-generated 'Barricaded door' anchors at 62-82s, 278-294s, 322-340s.

C.name: Pipeline Without Automatic Hook Contract
C.role: Controlled ablation test of Hook Contract constraint
C.description: Exact same base prompt, input pack, scene manifest, action candidates, and 3-part requirement as B, but removing the automatic bogus 'Barricaded door' SERIES HOOK CONTRACT block. Tests whether Gemini can choose appropriate openers and avoid the Part 2 spoiler when freed from anchor constraints.
C.format: 3-Part Serialized Highlight Cuts with Unconstrained Openers

D.name: Media-Grounded Editorial Director
D.description: Media-grounded story scope architecture: Gemini selects scope [28s - 345s], formulates a central viewer question, selects opening strategy (conflict_teaser_rewind), assigns open loops, allocates information budget, and builds an exact causal EDL that downstream code cannot mutate.
D.format: Single 68.0s Media-Grounded Director Spine with Causal Beat Graph
